SELECT DISTINCT b.id AS value,b.resource_desc AS label FROM system_docking.api_system_index_resource a LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_system_resource b ON a.resource_id=b.id LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_platform_index_info c ON a.index_id=c.id LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_interface_system_platform_info d ON c.platform_id = d.id LEFT JOIN system_docking.api_interface_system_info e ON d.system_id = e.id WHERE b.is_enable = '1' AND c.is_enable = '1' AND c.is_monitor = '1' AND d.is_enable = '1'
AND e.system_code=#{params.system_code}
